ui-ink.name: Ink and watercolour interface parts
ui-ink.brief: interface art for a hand-painted fantasy tabletop game: ink linework with soft watercolour washes, an earthy muted palette of warm charcoal, aged bronze, cream parchment and a little ember orange. Crafted and tactile but restrained: it frames content, it doesn't compete with it. No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols of real organisations, no watermark. On a genuinely transparent background (real alpha channel); nothing but the object itself, no cast shadow beyond its own edge.
ui-ink.use: Painted interface parts: frames, button plates, rings, dividers, corners and icons (AI-generated, reviewed before release)

ui-ink-tile.name: Ink and watercolour interface textures
ui-ink-tile.brief: interface art for a hand-painted fantasy tabletop game: ink linework with soft watercolour washes, an earthy muted palette of warm charcoal, aged bronze, cream parchment and a little ember orange. Crafted and tactile but restrained: it frames content, it doesn't compete with it. No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols of real organisations, no watermark. It must tile seamlessly: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top into the bottom, with no border, no vignette and even lighting. It fills the whole square.
ui-ink-tile.use: Painted interface textures: parchment and the dark chrome (AI-generated, reviewed before release)

ui-icon-ink.name: Ink and watercolour action icons
ui-icon-ink.brief: interface art for a hand-painted fantasy tabletop game: ink linework with soft watercolour washes, an earthy muted palette of warm charcoal, aged bronze, cream parchment and a little ember orange. Crafted and tactile but restrained: it frames content, it doesn't compete with it. No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols of real organisations, no watermark. A sheet of nine game action icons in a three-by-three grid, evenly spaced with clear gaps: each a cream ink line drawing with a soft watercolour wash and small touches of ember orange and aged bronze, centred on its own dark charcoal rounded-square tile with a thin aged-bronze edge, readable at 24 pixels. The same line weight, tile and style for all nine, matching the attached icons. Genuinely transparent between and around the tiles.
ui-icon-ink.use: Painted action icons for the hotbar and buttons (AI-generated, reviewed before release)

cover-ink.name: Ink and watercolour settlement covers
